units: pixels and seconds; image x to the right, y downward; full-resolution pixel coordinates
view: camera looks straight down (top-down / bird's-eye) onto flat brown dirt ground; the motion plane is the ground plane, facing the camera

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of top and bottom background strips vs frame 0: shift 0.00 px in every tested frame)
camera.perspective: none usable: orthographic-looking top-down view, flat ground, no horizon/vanishing points; one metres-per-pixel scale applies to the whole ground plane

objects.name: raccoon
objects.description: the only moving object: grey raccoon with a black/white ringed tail and a light-tan pointed snout, seen from above, walking in +x (left to right) along image row y ~ 728
objects.visible_frames: 0-71 (entirely in view in every frame, never occluded)
objects.reference_point: cx_mask, cy_mask = centroid of the full top-down silhouette (tail + body + head + legs); best proxy for the rig root. bbox_cx/bbox_cy also given (noisier, swings with tail/snout).

size_px.note: length along motion axis (image x) = bbox_w; width = image-y extent; legs that swing out widen it. Vertical (world) height is not observable in this top-down view.

objects.name: raccoon_shadow
objects.description: long dark shadow of the raccoon cast to the lower-left (behind it); moves with it; excluded from the mask

objects.name: canopy_right
